content: {"phoneNote":"The license-plate phone number and zigzag key divider give it character, but address, hours and 'Navodila za pot' are repeated in three separate contact blocks down the page.","desktopNote":"The hero is strong, but below it the page runs out of material: 'Kje delam' is a near-empty band with two tiny labels, the prices leave the right third blank and the closing headline is oversized.","phone":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":3,"spacing":3,"clutter":2,"distinctiveness":4},"desktop":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":3,"imagery":3,"spacing":2,"clutter":2,"distinctiveness":4},"fixes":["Merge the blue info block, the 'Pokličite me' block and 'Obiščite nas' into one closing contact section; keep the hero phone plate as the single primary action.","Desktop: fill the empty right side of 'Kje delam' and 'Cene' with a map or workshop photo, and cap the 'Pokličite me' headline so it does not swallow the screen.","Add a second photo (key-cutting machine, cylinders, van) in the services or process section to anchor the long typographic run below the hero."],"blockers":["Phone: address, opening hours and 'Navodila za pot' appear three times (blue block, 'Pokličite me' section, 'Obiščite nas') plus phone repeated in footer – duplicate contact blocks.","Phone hero: 'Navodila za pot' link sits directly under the identical link in the header, duplicating the same action twice in the first screen."]}
